excludedCandidates.rationale: StepStone publicly presents sPower only as a historical infrastructure co-investment case study. Current ownership as of the census date is not supported.
Presented only as a SPRIM private-markets case study without a publicly identified operating company attributable to StepStone's infrastructure strategy under the census inclusion rules.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Undisclosed infrastructure co-investments and SPVs
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Official materials confirm infrastructure co-investment capability, but public disclosures generally stop at fund interests, SPVs, or aggregated portfolio descriptions rather than naming current operating companies, preventing asset-level attribution.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Review confidential portfolio schedules or investor reporting that identifies the underlying operating companies for co-investment and continuation vehicles.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Generic fund interests and opaque co-investment SPVs
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Registered-fund disclosures include fund interests and investment vehicles without sufficient look-through information to identify specific North American infrastructure companies or platforms.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Do not infer operating-company ownership absent public look-through disclosure.
